name: opus-video-studio
description: Code-driven UI motion and product videos, with managed Opus video and audio generation.

interface.shortDescription: Create UI motion, video, and audio with Opus.
interface.longDescription: Opus Video Tools provides Motion UI for editable local product motion, Media Tools for standalone audio/images and job recovery, and Video Director for directing and optimizing all supported AI video models. Use the bundled Seedance guidance only for Seedance. Reuse your framework or a local Remotion project without requiring a gallery template.
defaultPrompt: Use Motion UI to create a launch video based on my product’s real interface.
Use Video Director to optimize this brief and generate a video with my selected model.
Use Media Tools to generate a voiceover for this text.
